snippet.title: Once Human | Global Console Launch on Aug 25 (PT)
snippet.description:
The wait is officially OVER. 🎮💥

Mark your calendars, Metas! Once Human is officially bringing its strange world survival experience to PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S on August 25 (PT)! 🗓️

Get ready to immerse yourself like never before—experience the ultimate horror thrill entirely in First-Person Mode, fully optimized for consoles with stunning visuals and seamless gameplay.

Your new journey begins here.

👉 Wishlist now & Pre-order:
- PlayStation 5:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015762
- XBOX Series X|S:
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/once-human/9n0qwxc09mpt

🚨 EXCLUSIVE PRE-ORDER BONUS🚨
Pre-order starting TODAY to secure your exclusive console-only rewards! Don't miss out on these limited-time items to kickstart your survival journey.

#OnceHuman #PS5 #XBOX #OnceHumanConsole
